why: Issue #1014. An action is renamed in `DEV_ACTIONS` and nowhere else, so the button the markup labels keeps the old word while the catalogue -- which arms it and words its result line -- says the new one. The markup-against-catalogue case catches it from the catalogue's side; the literal-label case would, too.
